text:
morgan_fin: FYI — BlueMesa opened a dispute (TKT-12345). They say a POC promo credit (agreed by solutions) never applied to Apr invoice. Invoice 78901 shows full charge. Can someone approve a manual credit + reissue?

sara_csr: ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you paste the invoice line(s) that should have been credited? we need merchant & product codes for the credit memo.

morgan_fin: sure — pasted from invoice:```
Invoice 78901
- Reserved capacity: $12,000
- Usage overage: $1,250
- Promo applied: $0 (expected POC_PROMO_50pct)
Total: $13,250
```

alex_ops: quick question — was the promo a percent off reserved capacity only or entire invoice? docs from sales say 50% off reserved for first 2 months.

morgan_fin: agreed with sales: 50% off reserved capacity line only. So expected credit = $6,000. We should leave usage/overage alone.

james_cfo: pinging in — $6k one-time goodwill/POC credit. What's the impact to revenue recognition and which GL to use?

sara_csr: GL for promo credits is 5105 (COGS: credits). I'll create credit memo to reduce AR and reissue invoice as corrected. Will tag as "POC_PROMO_ADJ".

james_cfo: approved. Please include short justification: "Sales-approved POC promo not applied; customer requested; TKT-12345." :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0042 created for $6,000. Reissued invoice: 78901-R1 (net due $7,250). Link: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/78901-R1

sara_csr: done — emailed customer with reissued invoice and applied credit. Closing ticket after BlueMesa confirms. cc @morgan_fin for handoff.

morgan_fin: thanks all. please log in the partner playbook that sales needs to confirm promo flags before billing cutoff to avoid repeat. :memo:
